svg.title: Shennong object-centered workflow
svg.desc: Inputs and quality control feed a Shennong object, analysis modules produce versioned results, and the plot registry drives validated figure export.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, sans-serif
Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: 输入 -> 对象 -> 分析模块 -> versioned result -> 可视化与交付
